read.thesis: BHP FY26 copper ~1,953 kt (-3%) with FY27 copper guided down to 1,650–1,800 kt on Escondida grade decline, while copper price rose 35% to US$5.74/lb and Jansen impairment ~US$2.3bn signals capital discipline strain.

triggers.label: Copper realised US$5.74/lb, +35%
triggers.quote: copper prices around 35 per cent higher than a year ago

triggers.label: FY27 copper guided down to 1,650–1,800 kt
triggers.quote: Copper production for FY27 is expected to be between 1,650 and 1,800 kt predominately as a result of the forecast grade decline at Escondida.

triggers.label: Spence capacity fix sanctioned, Copper SA doubling studied
triggers.quote: The Spence Concentrator Upgrade Recovery project, which upgrades the flotation circuit to increase residence time and improve recoveries, was sanctioned in June 2026

guidance.quote: Copper production for FY27 is expected to be between 1,650 and 1,800 kt predominately as a result of the forecast grade decline at Escondida.
Iron ore production for FY27 is expected to be between 260 and 272 Mt.
within the range for WAIO and towards the top end for BMA
The Group's net debt balance as at 30 June 2026 is expected to be ~US$9 bn

red_flags.label: Jansen impairment ~US$2.3bn and cost overrun pressure
Spence grade and processing decline
red_flags.quote: Spence production decreased due to ongoing challenges with processing complex ore at the concentrator

red_flags.label: Carrapateena conveyor failure, up to 8 weeks impact
red_flags.quote: The recovery and replacement process is expected to result in up to eight weeks of mine production impact.
